registration.selection: Retain fresh commits first, then fixed historical source order and ascending line: initial SAT, satisfiable=true, original_solution only. Exclude the known positive-control canonical type, canonical duplicates, and primary Hamming distances below the registered minimum. No realization outcome filtering; no claim of uniform or all-fresh sampling.
registration.validation_cnf: Original CNF only. Historical two-proof-cut generation is a separately disclosed reused stratum. No diversity or proof-cut clause enters benchmark flippability, feedback, or acceptance.
registration.deadline: One validation child; parent wall watchdog terminates blocked native SAT calls. Committed rows survive interruption.

validation.digest_format: one byte0/1 for each original variable1..nvars; omitted variables=false
validation.method: Fresh original-CNF solver, complete primary assumptions, explicit every-clause scan; no generation constraints
